entities.name: Dominik Hieronim Radziwiłł
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prince Dominik Hieronim Radziwiłł was a Polish-Lithuanian nobleman who was Ordynat of Nesvizh and Olyka and owner of Biržai, Dubingiai, Słuck and Kapyl estates. He took part in Napoleon's invasion of Russia in 1812 and later died of wounds after the Battle of Hanau.
